legend: Small crowded tissue fragment of cells that are relatively uniform in size, with a high N:C ratio and single, highly pleomorphic nuclei with fine chromatin, variably prominent nucleoli, and a suggestion of nuclear pseudoinclusions in some nuclei. The pale blue eccentric cytoplasm in some cells is vacuolated (Giemsa).

Tissue fragment consisting of cells that range from polygonal to spindle, with large ovoid to elongated, highly pleomorphic nuclei with finely granular chromatin and often prominent and large nucleoli (Pap).

Tissue fragment shows crowded, often epithelioid cells with relatively dense cytoplasm that in some cells contains vacuoles or rudimentary lumina. The nuclei are large and highly pleomorphic, with large nucleoli (cell block, H&E).
